note: Koldun — first playable class of Baba Yaga (ORIGINAL IP: a Slavic hedge-witch who bargains with the forest). Three trees on the 8x8 grid; per-tier hard-point caps 3/2/2/1; prereq edges carry 1 point; synergy lines read hard points only. All names original to this world. manaCost rows are ORIGINAL design values: the first mana pool is lean, so a row-0 weave costs 2–4 and a row-2 finisher 8–12 — weaving more than a full pool's worth needs the belt (napitek-manny) until regen lands.

trees.name: Popioly
trees.flavour: Ember magic: sparks carried in ash, a hearth that hunts.

trees.name: Uroki
trees.flavour: Hexes whispered backwards: dusk, hag-sleep, numbness, the spoken curse.

trees.name: Krag
trees.flavour: Chalk circles and iron wards; a shove that walks things backwards into the dark.

skills.name: Iskra
skills.flavour: A single cinder flicked from the tongue, faithful as flint.

skills.name: Zarzewie
skills.flavour: Tinder-cloth tossed over roots; what it catches does not cool on schedule.

skills.name: Pochodnia
skills.flavour: A torch that plants itself where it was thrown and keeps watch.

skills.name: Popielna Burza
skills.flavour: The sky over the clearing turns the colour of a cold stove; ash falls hot.

skills.name: Pomrok
skills.flavour: A piece of dusk folded into a sleeve; the cut it makes does not bleed, it dims.

skills.name: Zmora
skills.flavour: Sent to sit on a sleeping thing's chest until it forgets which way is up.

skills.name: Otupienie
skills.flavour: Not pain — the absence where pain should have arrived.

skills.name: Kletwa
skills.flavour: Spoken once, backwards, into running water. The water finishes it.

skills.name: Kolo
skills.flavour: Chalk, a breath, a line most things choose not to cross.

skills.name: Napor
skills.flavour: An open palm at empty air; ten paces away, something's nose breaks.

skills.name: Zaslona
skills.flavour: A curtain of birch-shadow drawn across the doorway and across you.

skills.name: Kamienna Skora
skills.flavour: River-bed stone borrowed for an afternoon; it gives itself back all at once.
